title: dianthus gaditanus subsp. mauritanicus
intro: Dianthus gaditanus subsp. mauritanicus, commonly known as the Moroccan pink, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family that is native to North Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus gaditanus subsp. mauritanicus include calming the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiseptic properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
